                                 native_id, fingerprint, raw, status, match_transaction_id)
         SELECT $1, * FROM unnest($2::int2[], $3::int4[], $4::date[], $5::numeric[], $6::text[],
                                  $7::text[], $8::text[], $9::jsonb[], $10::text[], $11::uuid[])
